title: Enode EV Status State of Charge Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=enode:vehicle soc_pct=*
| stats sum(soc_pct) as total_value, avg(soc_pct) as avg_value by make
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks make values by total and average state of charge across Enode EV status events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `soc_pct` values for each Enode EV status event and review total and average state of charge by make.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total state of charge.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which make shows the biggest state of charge numbers in your Enode EV status data.
